template.lifetime.reason: birthRootCapability: offline authoring at a genesis description (no loaded image); loaded authoring overrides the window and budget with the record (birthRootCapabilityAt `current`), and its time-window lemma

config.grainBirthTariff.reason: profileDescription: the deployment's genesis description beside runtimeParameters (the profile semantics hash these); birth contexts name it as their genesis source and checkSource/BirthRuntimeProfile.select compare it to the pinned genesis. It quotes no price: births and quotes price from the loaded platform record; and the `genesis` command, which builds the genesis image and checks its source against the operator's genesis manifest
